preparation_checklist: Bring a photo ID every day — required at Interchange pantries (Village Church and St. Mark AME)
Call The Gathering (414-272-4122) before your first visit to confirm no appointment is needed
Call SVdP Harambee Kitchen (414-249-3866) and Cross Roads Kitchen (414-649-9555) to confirm cost and any entry requirements
Call COA Goldin Center (414-265-7696) before Sat 9/12 and Wed 9/16 visits — hours unverified since 2024
Call Maccanon Brown (414-404-0600) before Tue 9/15 pantry visit — confirm 53206 is served and hours still current
Call Ebenezer Stone Ministries (414-488-8070) before Sat 9/12 — pop-up is weather-dependent and 2×/month only
At every pantry, tell staff you have no kitchen and ask specifically for no-cook or ready-to-eat items
You have refrigeration — cold items (yogurt, cheese, deli items) are safe to take if offered
For Sunday 9/13 breakfast and lunch: no verified source found — consider asking at Saturday pantry for extra no-cook items to carry over
Dial 2-1-1 (Wisconsin 211) any time for real-time food resource help and emergency referrals
